name: ClickHouse
summary: Run queries and load Parquet partitions into ClickHouse Cloud or a self-hosted server over the HTTP interface. Loads are idempotent by partition and revision (ADR 0012).

fields.name: username
fields.label: User name
fields.help: default is the built-in user of a new self-hosted server.

fields.name: password
fields.label: Password
fields.help: Empty only for a local server that allows it.

settings.name: port
settings.label: HTTP port
settings.help: 8443 for HTTPS, 8123 for plain HTTP on a self-hosted server.

egress.note: 8443 (HTTPS) and 9440 (native, TLS) are the encrypted defaults, used by ClickHouse Cloud. 8123 and 9000 are the plain defaults of a self-hosted server.

operators.summary: Run a SQL query and keep the result as Parquet.
Insert Parquet into a table over HTTP, once per partition and revision.

notes: ByteHouse speaks a ClickHouse-compatible protocol but has its own connector. Ogun does not create the target table.
